name: Mow Crew
hook: Mow the street's lawns in perfect stripes.
how: Ride over a yard with a price sign to cut it: straight rows leave neat light and dark stripes, and it pays once 95% is cut, split by who mowed it (neat stripes earn a PERFECT bonus). Empty your bag at the truck, dodge the flower beds and gnomes, and don't wake the dog.
controls: WASD or arrow keys, or hold the mouse where to drive; on a phone, drag anywhere
uses: Bot crews pick yards and mow them in rows until enough people join.
The host's browser keeps every lawn's grass, pays the yards, runs the clock and the dogs; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Work days of three minutes with a results card between them.
Everyone sees the same stripes appear as anyone mows.
Your savings and upgrades are kept for you between visits.
Raise every yard's price with no new deploy; an event's title shows on screen.
ideas: Add a leaf blower power-up that clears a whole row at once
Make it autumn, with leaves to rake instead of grass
Add a rain shower that makes all the grass grow faster
